name: subagent-orchestration
description: Main-controller workflows for long-running Codex tasks, multi-agent delegation, evidence checks, and test regressions.

interface.longDescription: Subagent Orchestration helps Codex plan, delegate, verify, hand off, and close long-running multi-agent work with explicit acceptance gates and evidence checks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use subagent-orchestration to coordinate a long-running task with a main controller, bounded subagents, acceptance gates, evidence verification, handoffs, and cleanup. For testing work, use delegated-testing by default: the main controller plans and accepts evidence, while UI/test subagents perform the actual browser, API, data, screenshot, or role-switching actions unless an explicit exception is recorded.
